summary.text: Nelly Burdette is the Democratic candidate for the Rhode Island State Senate, District 17, in the November 3, 2026 general election, having won the September 9, 2026 Democratic primary.
Her campaign website describes her as a clinical health psychologist and healthcare leader.

paragraphs.text: Nelly Burdette's campaign website says she was born in Ukraine and raised in Texas as a first-generation immigrant.
It describes her as a clinical health psychologist and healthcare leader with more than two decades of experience, and says her work helped integrate mental and physical health care in Rhode Island.
The site also says she is a cancer survivor and has been a small business owner at different points in her career.
Burdette is running for the first time, according to her campaign website, which calls her "not a career politician."
The campaign says it focuses on affordable primary care, housing people can afford, supporting healthy aging, and helping small businesses survive and thrive.
